formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's USD₮0 allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`. It replaces any earlier allowance and does not add to it.
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so any other pending permit signed with the same nonce stops working.
The signature works only until `deadline`. It is checked against the domain name from name(), version "1", chainId and the token proxy address.
formats.shown: The screen says "Authorize spending of tokens" and shows the spender as a raw address, the maximum amount in USD₮0 ("Unlimited" at or above 2^255), the deadline as a date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit shows the spender as a raw hex address, so the signer cannot see who it is.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, Permit format: {"path": "spender", "label": "Spender", "format": "raw"}. Case 0 renders Spender "0xE592427A0AEce92De3Edee1F18E0157C05861564" (Uniswap V3 SwapRouter), with no name. ArbitrumExtension.sol _permit: `_approve(owner_, spender, value);`
findings.fix: Change the spender field to {"format": "addressName", "params": {"types": ["contract", "eoa"], "sources": ["local", "ens"]}} so wallets can show a name for a known spender.

findings.title: Permit tests do not cover the "Unlimited" threshold path for the value.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json, value field: "threshold": "0x8000…", "message": "Unlimited". The only test, case 0, uses value 250000000, which renders "250 USD₮0".
findings.fix: Add a test case with value = 2^256-1 and expect "Max spending amount: Unlimited".

findings.title: The Permit intent does not name the token, the amount or the spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", with no interpolatedIntent. The amount and spender appear only as fields.

Permit(address owner,address spender,uin.worst: Permit shows the spender as a raw hex address, so the signer cannot see who it is.
